summary: Remove the installer logo board texture in both GTK headers. API impact: none; native asset rendering only.

guide.reason: Visual background correction preserves installation steps, choices, layout allocations and recovery behavior.

api.reason: Local asset loading and GTK rendering change no Controller operation, Core command/result, client-facing API or Debian question contract.

state.reason: Installer presentation and input handling only; the installed host gains no new durable setting and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: Build isolated GTK initrd; prove native pixel regression fails old background; pass final QEMU/KVM wizard and diskless progress reviews, initrd/source retention and installer checks; inspect captures. No full ISO or real installation rerun.
